newsitem.title: USA: Millicom to restructure, spin off units.
newsitem.headline: Millicom to restructure, spin off units.

text.p: Millicom International Cellular SA said on Tuesday it will restructure its operations, in part by spinning off its Asian operations into a separate, publicly listed company.
Millicom said it will also consider partners or buyers for its Latin American operations.
As part of its restructuring the company plans to make an exchange or tender offer for its subordinated notes and also to set a share repurchase program.

"We consider that there is substantial value within Millicom's operations which is currently not reflected in the company's stock price," Jay Metcalfe, the president and chief executive, said in a statement. "The plan will allow investors to clearly evaluate each part of the business."
Millicom was trading at 40-5/8 on Tuesday, up 5-1/8 on the day. Its 52-week high was 51-1/4.

Millicom said all the transactions would be done in 1997 and would be tax-free or substantially tax-free. The company plans to rename itself Millicom SA, with cellular phone operations and interests in Russia, the Baltics, Luxembourg and Africa; its Multinational Automated Clearing House SA subsidiary; and new ventures.
